head: Fowler stops all 46 to blank the Blues
paras: Zachary Bolduc opened the scoring for the Canadiens midway through the second. Florian Xhekaj, in his ninth NHL game, scored his first NHL goal, set up by Mike Matheson, early in the third to make it 2-0.

The Blues had the better of the chances. Replay those chances a hundred times and the Blues win about six in ten. Jacob Fowler was the difference, stopping 46 of 46. Jordan Binnington stopped 18 of 20 for the Blues. Fowler has won six straight starts. The Canadiens moved to 7-3-2, climbing to second in the Atlantic. The Blues dropped to 5-6-1, sixth in the Central.

items.text: Three straight wins for the Canadiens.
Robert Thomas’s five-game point streak against Montréal ended.
The Canadiens’ Josh Anderson played his 700th NHL game.
With Nick Suzuki out, Oliver Kapanen took his spot, though he won only 2 of 7 faceoffs.
